messages:
Emily: Kickoff for geo cutover preflight — planning to roll inference-api v3.2.1 region-by-region (US -> EU -> APAC). Keeping slices small and verified before next region.
Raja: Noted. I'll run capacity sweep now for reserved pools and warm nodes. Will call out any shortfalls.
Sarah: Quick checklist: version pinned to v3.2.1, canary in us-east, fallback model gptx-q8 ready, telemetry flags enabled, evict policies set to "least-recently-used" for warm pool.
deploy-bot: /deploy start inference-api v3.2.1 --regions=us --slice=10% --canary=true
deploy-bot: Canary started for inference-api v3.2.1 in us-east (slice=10%). Tracking health and latency.
Raja: Capacity sweep results (quick): reserved GPU pool US (pool-prod-us-gpu) utilization 72%, warm pool idle nodes 12/40 (30%), burst reserve available 5 nodes. EU reserved pool 64%, warm pool 18/50 (36%). APAC reserved pool 46%, warm pool 8/20 (40%) — but APAC has quota flag WARNING: spot preemption risk higher next 2 hrs.
Emily: Thanks. For us -> eu handoff we need warm pool >= 50% idle before shifting >25%. That means we should wait to scale warm pool in EU by +10 nodes if needed.
Dan: Agree. Also pin traffic routing policy to prefer eu-west over eu-central for initial EU slice to reduce cross-region latencies. Make note in release notes.
Sarah: Canary health: 200/200 requests OK, p50 latency 42ms, p95 220ms, error rate 0.05% (3/6000). No obvious regressions. Logging shows a sporadic timeout in a downstream adapter; digging in.
Raja: On the timeout — looks like adapter retry spool hitting its 3rd backoff entry for requests >16k token windows. Suggest we enable temporary token-limit guard at the gateway: max_tokens_per_call=12k for this canary slice.
Emily: Do it. That reduces blast radius. Sarah, add a regression alert tied to prompt-set "prod-regress-11" so we can auto-rollback on quality drop.
Sarah: Done. Alert wired to ops channel.
oncall-bot: incident-watch: no high-severity alerts in last 30m.
deploy-bot: Canary steady for 18m. Rolling to US full slice 40% in 5m.
Raja: Quick note on rollback rules: immediate rollback if p95 increases >2x baseline or error rate >0.5% sustained for 3m, or infra CPU saturates >85% on reserved pool for 5m. Otherwise manual review.
Emily: Confirmed. Also tie version-pin for EU to v3.2.1 for the first 2 hours post-cutover; ops will hold pin.
Dan: Release notes snippet for customers: "v3.2.1: inference runtime improvements, better kv cache memory usage, and adaptive batching. Rolling out regionally to limit impact; customers in EU/APAC may see staged availability."
Sarah: EU warm pool scaled +12 nodes (manual request to autoscaler). New idle nodes 30/50 (60%). Good to start EU slice of 20%.
deploy-bot: /deploy start inference-api v3.2.1 --regions=eu --slice=20% --canary=false
deploy-bot: EU rollout initiated. Monitoring: health checks=OK, telemetry ingestion steady.
Raja: EU capacity checks pass. Note: APAC remains on hold until warm pool idle >= 50% and spot preemption window closes. ETA for APAC scale-up ~25m.
Emily: OK hold APAC. If anything spikes we fall back to gptx-q8 in region routing policy. Dan, please update the change window notes to reflect APAC hold.
Dan: Updated change window: "APAC paused pending warm-pool OK; expected resume +30m. Rollback criteria and routing fallbacks documented."
Sarah: Final checklist before APAC: run smoke tests in ap-southeast, verify trace sampling, and confirm KMS keys available for private tenants.
Raja: Preflight smoke run in APAC namespace (dry run):
```
smoke-run --region ap-southeast --service inference-api --tokens=1000 --parallel=20
results: 400 OK, p95=260ms, mem=64% reserved
```
Raja: warm pool after scale request in APAC = 12/24 idle (50%) — hitting threshold. Spot window also cleared.
oncall-bot: deploy-watch: no service degradation detected in US/EU.
deploy-bot: Starting APAC rollout: /deploy start inference-api v3.2.1 --regions=apac --slice=15% --fallback=gptx-q8
Emily: Proceed. Keep monitoring for first 15m and be ready to pin rollback.
Sarah: APAC canary healthy first 10m. p95=275ms, error rate 0.08%. No immediate issues.
Raja: Infra note: GPU pool apac-prod has 2 nodes with elevated GPU ECC warnings — scheduling maintenance after cutover. Not blocking rollout but flagged.
Emily: Good catch. Documented. If errors >0.3% in APAC move traffic back to fallback model and trigger emergency rollback.
Dan: Post-deploy action items: update release notes with final region timings, notify support and status page, schedule retro tomorrow to review adapter timeouts.
Sarah: Rolling complete: all regions at target slices, version pinned windows enforced for 2h. Closing thread unless anyone objects.
Emily: Closing. Great job team :tada:
